en: A sepia-toned vintage postcard showing a large brick railway station building with arched windows and a central clock above the main entrance. A flag flies from the roof. In front of the station there is a landscaped square with flower beds, a road with an early/mid‑20th‑century car, and several pedestrians. The style and print layout suggest an early 20th‑century European postcard.
